(rule!
 (let ()
   (define toward #t)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define positions (grid-positions g))
   (define (value p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
   (define (active ps found)
     (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p found))) ps))
   (define (uniform-guide ps found)
     (let* ((rest (active ps found))
            (vals (remove-duplicates (map value rest))))
       (and (not (empty? rest)) (= (length vals) 1) (not (= (first vals) bg)))))
   (define (discover-lines found)
     (let* ((row-add
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (r)
                            (let ((ps (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range w))))
                              (if (uniform-guide ps found) (active ps found) '())))
                          (range h))))
            (after-rows (remove-duplicates (append found row-add)))
            (col-add
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (c)
                            (let ((ps (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range h))))
                              (if (uniform-guide ps after-rows) (active ps after-rows) '())))
                          (range w))))
            (next (remove-duplicates (append after-rows col-add))))
       (if (= (length next) (length found)) next (discover-lines next))))
   (define guides (discover-lines '()))
   (define mask
     (grid-from-fn h w
       (lambda (r c)
         (if (and (not (= (at g r c) bg)) (not (member (list r c) guides))) 1 0))))
   (define components (map obj-cells (objects-8 mask 0)))
   (define (colors cells) (map value cells))
   (define movers (filter (lambda (cells) (member 8 (colors cells))) components))
   (define targets
     (filter (lambda (cells)
               (and (not (empty? cells))
                    (andmap (lambda (p) (= (value p) 9)) cells)))
             components))
   (define (cells-of-color cells color)
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) color)) cells))
   (define (guide-cells color)
     (filter (lambda (p) (= (value p) color)) guides))
   (define (average xs) (/ (apply + xs) (length xs)))
   (define (opposite side)
     (case side ((T) 'B) ((B) 'T) ((L) 'R) (else 'L)))
   (define (target-side color target)
     (let* ((line (guide-cells color))
            (bb (bbox-of-cells line))
            (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb)) (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
            (th (+ 1 (- r2 r1))) (tw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
            (tr (average (map first target)))
            (tc (average (map second target)))
            (side (if (>= tw th)
                      (if (< (/ (+ r1 r2) 2) tr) 'T 'B)
                      (if (< (/ (+ c1 c2) 2) tc) 'L 'R))))
       (if toward side (opposite side))))
   (define (source-side mover color)
     (let* ((body (filter (lambda (p) (member (value p) '(8 9))) mover))
            (tabs (cells-of-color mover color))
            (vectors
              (apply append
                     (map (lambda (p)
                            (filter-map
                              (lambda (d)
                                (let ((q (list (- (first p) (first d))
                                               (- (second p) (second d)))))
                                  (if (member q body) d #f)))
                              cardinal-deltas))
                          tabs)))
            (dr (apply + (cons 0 (map first vectors))))
            (dc (apply + (cons 0 (map second vectors)))))
       (if (>= (abs dr) (abs dc))
           (if (< dr 0) 'T 'B)
           (if (< dc 0) 'L 'R))))
   (define (transform-delta tid dr dc)
     (case tid
       ((0) (list dr dc))
       ((1) (list dc (- dr)))
       ((2) (list (- dr) (- dc)))
       ((3) (list (- dc) dr))
       ((4) (list dr (- dc)))
       ((5) (list (- dr) dc))
       ((6) (list dc dr))
       (else (list (- dc) (- dr)))))
   (define (transform-side side tid)
     (let* ((v (case side ((T) '(-1 0)) ((B) '(1 0)) ((L) '(0 -1)) (else '(0 1))))
            (q (transform-delta tid (first v) (second v)))
            (dr (first q)) (dc (second q)))
       (if (>= (abs dr) (abs dc))
           (if (< dr 0) 'T 'B)
           (if (< dc 0) 'L 'R))))
   (define (tab-colors mover)
     (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 8)) (not (= v 9)))) (colors mover))))
   (define (placed mover target tid)
     (let* ((anchor (first (cells-of-color mover 9)))
            (relative
              (map (lambda (p)
                     (let ((q (transform-delta tid (- (first p) (first anchor))
                                                     (- (second p) (second anchor)))))
                       (list (first q) (second q) (value p))))
                   mover))
            (rel-nine (filter (lambda (x) (= (third x) 9)) relative))
            (shift
              (find-first values
                (apply append
                  (map (lambda (x)
                         (map (lambda (p)
                                (let* ((sr (- (first p) (first x)))
                                       (sc (- (second p) (second x)))
                                       (shifted-nine
                                         (sort (map (lambda (z) (list (+ (first z) sr)
                                                                         (+ (second z) sc)))
                                                    rel-nine)
                                               cell<)))
                                  (if (equal? shifted-nine (sort target cell<))
                                      (list sr sc) #f)))
                              target))
                       rel-nine)))))
       (if shift
           (map (lambda (x) (list (+ (first x) (first shift))
                                  (+ (second x) (second shift))
                                  (third x)))
                relative)
           #f)))
   (define (orient mover target)
     (let* ((tabs (tab-colors mover))
            (tid
              (find-first
                (lambda (k)
                  (and
                    (andmap (lambda (color)
                              (equal? (transform-side (source-side mover color) k)
                                      (target-side color target)))
                            tabs)
                    (placed mover target k)))
                (range 8))))
       (placed mover target tid)))
   (define (nine-count cells) (length (cells-of-color cells 9)))
   (define erased
     (erase-cells g (apply append (append movers targets)) bg))
   (define state
     (foldl
       (lambda (mover acc)
         (let* ((out (first acc))
                (remaining (second acc))
                (target (find-first (lambda (x) (= (length x) (nine-count mover))) remaining))
                (stamp (orient mover target)))
           (list (paint-cells out stamp)
                 (remove target remaining))))
       (list erased targets)
       movers))
   (first state)))
